```{ojs}
//| echo: false
d3 = require("d3@7")
slider = require("d3-simple-slider@2")

container = html`<div id="slider"></div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof d3slider = {
  // Create a container to hold the slider SVG
  const div = html`<div></div>`;

  // Create slider state and a setter for reactivity
  let value = 50; // default initial value

  // Create the SVG element
  const width = 300, height = 70;
  const svg = d3.select(div)
    .append("svg")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .append("g")
    .attr("transform", "translate(30,30)");

  // Setup the horizontal slider
  const mySlider = slider.sliderHorizontal()
    .min(0)
    .max(100)
    .step(1)
    .width(200)
    .displayValue(true)
    .on("onchange", v => {
      value = v;
      div.value = value;  // Sets the .value property that Quarto/OJS watches
    });

  svg.call(mySlider);

  // Initialize
  mySlider.value(value);
  div.value = value;
  return div;
}


```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
double = d3slider * 2

  <div class="gray-box">
  Giva:  <mark>${double.toFixed(3)}</mark>
  m3/ha<br>
</div>`


```
